svg.desc: An animated illustration of the real StellarSearch UI: connect Freighter, search, receive HTTP 402, sign a Soroban auth entry, retry with X-PAYMENT, let the facilitator settle 0.001 USDC on Stellar testnet, and render results.

g.text: Real web search for AI agents · 0.001 USDC per query · settled on Stellar via x402
